prompts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: a production sprite component sheet for one connectable decoration family in the 2D top-down puzzle game ANIMOL, Sunset Sanctum. Truly transparent background. Wide landscape canvas about1536x1024. Three clearly separated components, with large empty transparent gaps: an extremely long HORIZONTAL straight carrier in the UPPER LEFT, a long VERTICAL north-south straight carrier down the RIGHT edge, and a small separate hub/corner-cap in the LOWER LEFT. The right vertical strip must have clear long straight parallel sides and show the same materials as the horizontal one. Each strip has open straight-cut ends with NO end posts, feet or caps at the ends: they will tile continuously. The hub conceals the center connection of L,T,cross. Orthogonal floor geometry, horizontal axis remains exactly horizontal and north-south remains exactly vertical, camera elevated slightly to show short south-facing thickness, NO isometric diamond perspective. Very crisp thick nearly black navy outer contours with thinner minimal internal lines. Primary shape language consists of long straight lines, triangles, trapezoids, sharp corners and wedges; all shapes angular. Flat broad base-color fills and a single clearly cut polygon shadow per material, 2–3 tonal steps, vivid but controlled. Match an ivory stone and brass/copper celestial sanctuary, navy shadows and cool blue accents. No gradients, airbrushing, glow bloom, texture, grain, round loops, organic round curls, photorealism, 3D render, text, labels, grid, floor/background, people, moon or planets. Native transparent RGBA art, whole silhouettes fully visible. Subject: connected STAR BANNER PARTITION. Navy blue cloth screens bearing one bold ivory four-point star and small copper angular hem details, suspended on thin brass horizontal rails. Fold shapes are just two large angular planes, no many soft folds. Horizontal component is a very wide continuous band of star cloth panels under a single continuous gold top rail; NO vertical posts between each small cloth. Right component is a long thin top-down row of the exact same banners receding in north-south direction with parallel gold rails visible on either side, square to camera, not a rotated horizontal facade. Lower-left hub is a small ivory-and-brass faceted support with a navy star pennant that can visually cap a junction. This is a decorative partition, not a functional game gate or machine.
